name: two-axis-review
description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, merge-base, or a PR) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards, Glossary, and ADRs?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/PRD asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents, grades findings P0/P1/P2, and reports them side by side.
